_about: Corrected card text, keyed by full name, for cards whose text is mangled in both sources (lorcana-cards.raw.json and lorcast-cards.json). bin/build_db.dart uses the text here instead. Only the official printed wording goes here, with what was wrong.

Mulan - Imperial General.text:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 {i} to play this on top of one of your characters named Mulan.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
EXCEPTIONAL LEADER Whenever this character challenges another character, your other characters gain "This character can challenge ready characters" this turn.
Mulan - Imperial General.why: Bulk text has a stray quote after the story name (EXCEPTIONAL LEADER"); Lorcast's text.

Mystical Tree - Mama Odie's Home.text:
NOT BAD At the start of your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from chosen character here to chosen opposing character.
HARD-EARNED WISDOM At the start of your turn, if you have a character named Mama Odie here, gain 1 lore.
Mystical Tree - Mama Odie's Home.why: Bulk text lacks the second ability (HARD-EARNED WISDOM); Lorcast's text.

Naveen's Ukulele.text: MAKE IT SING 1 {i}, Banish this item - Chosen character counts as having +3 cost to sing songs this turn.
Naveen's Ukulele.why: Bulk text lost the cost (1 {i}, Banish this item); Lorcast's text.

Owl Island - Secluded Entrance.text:
TEAMWORK For each character you have here, you pay 1 {i} less for the first action you play each turn.
LOTS TO LEARN Whenever you play a second action in a turn, gain 3 lore.
Owl Island - Secluded Entrance.why: Bulk text lacks the second ability (LOTS TO LEARN); Lorcast's text.

Pixie Dust.text: FAITH AND TRUST {e}, 2 {i} - Chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Evasive until the start of your next turn. (While challenging, they get +2 {s}. Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
Pixie Dust.why: Bulk text lost the cost ({e}, 2 {i}); Lorcast's text, with its "{2} {I}" written "2 {i}" and the reminder's "{1}" as {s}.

Ratigan - Very Large Mouse.text: THIS IS MY KINGDOM When you play this character, exert chosen opposing character with 3 {s} or less. Choose one of your characters and ready them. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
Ratigan - Very Large Mouse.why: Bulk text says "read them" for "ready them"; Lorcast's text.

Swing Into Action.text: Chosen character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
Swing Into Action.why: bulk: "gins" for "gains"; not in the Lorcast list

The Boss Is On A Roll.text:
(A character with cost 3 or more can {e} to sing this song for free.)
Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Put any number of them on the top or the bottom of your deck in any order. Gain 1 lore.
The Boss Is On A Roll.why: bulk: "on the top of the bottom" for "on the top or the bottom"; not in the Lorcast list
